keyFindings.summary: Distinct live skill-advisor SQLite state exists under both mcp-server and mcp_server paths while current config names only the canonical hyphenated path.
Three launcher programs plus shared supervision total 8,457 lines and intentionally implement different daemon lifecycle policies.
Three package-local shared-payload implementations total 2,373 lines and are protected by an isolation policy that creates drift cost.
Four production modules retain guarded metrics calls behind a provider that always disables emission and implements no-op methods.
A 4,667-line resume and shadow-parity pair composes a parallel transactional architecture not referenced by active research YAML.
Generated production routing preserves phase-numbered topology and carries seven distinct hub compilers totaling 3,155 lines.
Four deep commands retain legacy bodies and compiled contracts, with fix mode concatenating both representations.
Thirteen agent definitions are packaged in each of three runtime trees, and the two Markdown inventories already omit deep-alignment.
Committed hidden scan scripts embed one developer workstation's absolute repository and spec paths.
The plugin-generated rotated log is not ignored because the repository ignores *.log but not *.log.*.

ruledOutDirections: Delete cli-exit-taxonomy-smoke.cjs merely because it is manual rather than CI-wired.
Delete check-no-spec-imports.cjs; it is invoked by a GitHub workflow and a foundation test.
Delete mk-skill-advisor-bridge.mjs; the OpenCode plugin spawns it.
Delete legacy deep-command bodies; the renderer consumes them in both supported modes.
Delete numbered compiled routers; the runtime engine loads them dynamically.
Treat runtime-specific agent differences as corruption.
Treat root MCP config symlinks as duplicate stale files.
Treat generated scan inventories as accidental residue without accounting for benchmark and regeneration contracts.
